output.explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 144 lines / 9,802 characters to 98 lines / 6,506 characters: 31.9% fewer lines and 33.6% fewer characters. Five peripherals expand meaningful concept nodes into context resolution, evaluation wiring, HTTP execution, resource cleanup, and architectural boundaries. [M] means modular structure, [C] call flow, [O] ownership, and [D] data dependency; '<-' denotes injected dependencies. Positions use measured text dimensions with gaps between trees.

Evidence is limited to context.json and seed.json. The sources and evals peripherals derive from bootstrap.ts; requests from vitePlugin.ts and both route factories; lifetime from bootstrap.ts and vitePlugin.ts; rules from dependencies.test.ts. Browser composition remains grounded in App.tsx and services.ts. Added details absent from the seed include distinct cwd/source-root inputs, exact storage collection names, combined eval-handler guards, preparation before streaming headers, error response codes, and differences between the two architecture tests' exclusions.

Corrections and qualifications: instances omitted from the backend return value are not necessarily inaccessible through injected services, so the central tree says only that they are not directly returned. The Vite adapter passes socket permission flags; enforcement inside the unprovided socket implementation is not established. Definitions responses are sent before the finally block removes the close listener. Architecture restrictions are static checks of literal import specifiers and syntactic callee names, not proof of universal runtime enforcement.

Uncertainty: sourceClassification and delegated service/handler implementations are not supplied, and tests were not executed. Cleanup shows invocation order, not completion or transitive release of resources; the shown sequence has no failure-isolation wrapper. Without an HTTP server, attach registers no close-triggered cleanup. The binding header is tested for truthiness here; its validation and the mutation classifier's coverage cannot be inferred.

HTTP dispatch, request state and results
|-- [C] Middleware admission precedes namespace dispatch
|   |-- Outside /api and /internal -> next()
|   |-- Classified mutation + httpEnabled !== true + falsy binding header -> 403
|   |   `-- Header truthiness is checked here; validation is not shown
|   `-- Then require /api/ and an own key in routes
|       `-- /internal is intercepted but has no dispatch namespace here
|-- [C/O] Core definitions: POST /api/core/project/definitions
|   |-- Wrong method -> 405; ensureDefinitionsEnabled() before body read
|   |-- Read body -> create AbortController -> response.once('close', abort)
|   |-- Close callback aborts only if response.writableEnded is false
|   `-- await source.definitions(body, controller.signal)
|       |-- If response is not destroyed -> sendJson(200, result)
|       `-- finally removes close listener, also on failure
|-- [D] Core catalog requests
|   |-- Files/source -> ProjectSourceService; projection POST -> catalog.saveProjection
|   |-- Corpus-compactions calls catalog.requireProject() before method handling
|   |   |-- GET -> catalog.compactions(); POST -> application.upsertProjectFileCompaction
|   |   `-- POST success is 201; unsupported methods return 405
|   `-- Representations GET: history === 'current' ? 'current' : 'all'
|-- [M] Optional mapping handlers are gated by injected services
|   |-- Generated canvases need evalRuns
|   |-- Evals need evalRuns AND evalPrompts AND evalReferences
|   |-- Agent/chat/live/compare/integration/workflow handlers have their own guards
|   `-- Bootstrap supplies these services; unmatched requests end in 404
|-- [D] Workspace operations pass a 64 * 1024 * 1024 body limit
|   |-- POST records -> applyBatch; POST export -> portableExport
|   |-- POST import-contexts -> prepareImport; PUT workspace -> save
|   `-- GET records chooses 'current' only for history=current; otherwise 'all'
|-- [C] POST /api/mapping/prompt
|   |-- Read body -> await selection.prepare(body), before headers are sent
|   |-- Set 200, application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8
|   |-- Set cache-control: no-cache, no-transform; flushHeaders()
|   `-- await selection.run(input, progress callback)
|       |-- Callback -> sendEvent({type: 'progress', ...event})
|       `-- Success -> sendEvent({type: 'result', result}) -> response.end()
`-- [C] Errors thrown by the awaited namespace handler
    |-- Headers sent -> sendEvent({type: 'error', error: message})
    |   `-- End only if neither destroyed nor writableEnded
    `-- Headers not sent -> sendJson(status, error body)
        |-- RequestTooLarge -> 413; ProjectDiagramConflict -> 409
        |-- ApplicationError conflict -> 409; invalid-input -> 400
        |-- binary-source -> 415; storage-unavailable -> 503
        |-- lsp-disabled / ai-disabled -> 503 + LSP_DISABLED / AI_DISABLED code
        `-- Other errors -> 400; non-Error thrown values use 'request failed'
